summary:
Iter 707-708 FRONTEND-ONLY smoke — Employee Pending Approval Center + Tour Admin Report/Advances + Firm Master PWA Settings + Monthly Attendance grid speed. ALL FEATURES PASS.

(1) Employee (TEST50/123456, Kankani Enterprises): Home dashboard shows indigo 'Pending Approvals – 0' card (testID pending-approvals-card) → tapping opens /my-approvals. Screen renders all six tabs (ma-tab-all/pending/approved/rejected/returned/cancelled) with counts All(3), Approved(2), Cancelled(1). Note: TEST50 currently has 0 pending EC items (EC2608-0004 not present in inbox — see below), but the review request said this is fine — UI structure is what matters. Item cards (ma-item-EC2608-0003 etc.) expand to show Submitted/Last-action/Currently-with rows and 'Approval Timeline' with per-level history entries (verified 3 APPROVE steps rendered for EC2608-0003). Progress dots + line render correctly.

(2) Admin (super-admin session token): /tour-admin renders new tabs ta-tab-report and ta-tab-advances alongside settings. Report tab: rep-prev/rep-next month buttons render, current month header (2026-08), rep-download 'Excel' button visible, empty state 'No tours in 2026-08.' renders without errors. Advances tab: adv-filter-all/pending/paid/settled chips all render, empty-state message 'No tour advances yet — advances appear here when a tour with Advance Required is approved.' visible.

(3) Firm Master /firm-master → left-nav 'PWA Settings' section (17) renders. Attendance Data Management block with pwa-autodelete Switch, day chips (pwa-day-1/3/5/7/10/15) that appear when autodelete is ON with descriptive hint, red 'Wipe Last Month PWA Attendance' button (pwa-manual-wipe) — NOT clicked as requested. Screenshot Protection block with pwa-screenshot Switch renders. Toggled autodelete ON → chips appeared with day 5 selected (default); toggled OFF → chips hid; reloaded page → persistence confirmed (autodelete stayed OFF, screenshot stayed OFF). Wipe Audit Trail also renders 3 prior audit entries.

(4) /attendance-grid loads within ~6.5s (network-inclusive) for 127 employees with full grid rendered (IN/OUT columns, dates 01-31 header, all rows). grid-show-more button correctly NOT rendered because rowCount (127) ≤ 150 initial cap.

(5) Regression: /my-tours renders with 9 status counters + 'New Tour' button. /expense-claim-form renders Official Tour switch (exp-official-tour) at top of form. (Note: initial test used wrong path /expense-claim → 404 which is expected; correct route is /expense-claim-form.)

No console errors related to the tested features; the 401s in console are the routine unauthenticated /health polls before login. No red screens, no ObjectID leaks, no missing testIDs.

Cleanup: no test data created; PWA settings for cmp_527fecdd7c were toggled ON then OFF then persisted OFF (verified after reload) — screenshot_protection stayed OFF throughout. No PWA data was wiped.
critical_code_review_comments: my-approvals.tsx keyExtractor uses (`${i.type_key}-${i.record_id}`) which is fine, but the expanded-state key also does the same string concatenation on every render inline — extract to a memoized helper to avoid recreating the closure inside FlatList renderItem for large item lists.

PwaSettingsSection.tsx uses window.confirm/alert on web which is intentional but on iOS PWA installed (standalone) mode the wipe confirm shows a browser-style prompt not aligned with the app theme; consider unifying with the app's custom modal in a follow-up.

tour-admin.tsx now imports Report/Advances lazily via useEffect on tab change — good; but the polling for Advances is NOT set (only Settings/Requests poll). If an admin leaves the Advances tab open, a peer marking an advance paid won't reflect until manual refresh.
seed_data_creation: None. PWA settings for cmp_527fecdd7c toggled ON→OFF and left OFF (verified after reload). No tours/claims created. Wipe button NOT pressed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Employee login via /pin-login → Username tab → TEST50 / 123456 works; submit button text is 'Sign in securely' (not 'Login'). Expense claim route is /expense-claim-form (not /expense-claim). Admin UI testing pattern: navigate to /, page.evaluate localStorage.setItem('llc_session_token','testsess_98915ef8186e483d8b6292d0b975d2f3'), then navigate to target route. PWA Switch testIDs render as generic <div> with no aria-checked on web — assert visual state via day-chip presence (chips only render when autodelete ON) or via /api/admin/pwa-settings GET.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature-verification pass, no bug under investigation.
